last_episode_to_air.name: Thanks for everything
last_episode_to_air.overview: The series finale episode, in the week leading up to Sana's party for Eid, switches characters clip-to-clip, focusing on short stories by characters not given their own, full season. The episode deals with parental depression, love rejection, jealousy, friendship, mutual relationship support, and fear of abandonment.

name: SKAM
overview: The story of young teenagers and pupils from Hartvig Nissens upper secondary school in Oslo, and their troubles, scandals and everyday life. Each season is told from a different person's point of view.

seasons.name: Eva
seasons.overview: The first season takes place in the fall of 2015 with Eva Kviig Mohn as the main character. The storyline deals with Eva's difficult relationship with her boyfriend Jonas and the themes of loneliness, identity, belonging, and friendship.

seasons.name: Noora
seasons.overview: The second season is focused on Noora Amalie Sætre. It is about her relationship with William and deals with issues of friendship, feminism, eating disorders, self-image, violence, sexual violence, and the contemporaneous refugee crisis concerning Norwegian democracy.

seasons.name: Isak
seasons.overview: The third season is focused on Isak Valtersen. The season deals with Isak's burgeoning relationship with Even Bech Næsheim and is principally a coming-out story that deals with issues of love, sexual identity, authenticity, mental illness, religion, and friendship.

seasons.name: Sana
seasons.overview: The fourth and final season has Sana Bakkoush as the main character. The season deals with the Islamic religion, forbidden love, cyberbullying, friendship, and the Norwegian "russ" celebratory period.

tagline: There's only one thing we know for sure. That life is... now.
